job.location: Various School Sites in Newport Beach and Costa Mesa, CA

items.item_text: 01. Information I provide to the following supplemental questions will be reviewed as part of the application process. Questions that are not fully and completely answered will be considered grounds for disqualification from the examination process. Stating "see resume" in lieu of a complete response to these questions is not acceptable. Select "Yes" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
02. Do you have a high school diploma or equivalent? Options: Yes | No
03. Do you have a valid California Driver's License (or an out of state license and are willing to obtain a California Driver's License upon offer of employment)? Options: Yes | No

04. Do you have a valid First Aid/CPR certificate? Options: Yes, I have a current, valid certificate and have attached it to my application. | I am willing to obtain a valid certificate within the first six months of employment. | I do not have a certificate and am not willing to obtain one
05. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have performing athletic equipment repair? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more
06. How many years of verifiable job related experience do you have performing general custodial duties? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1-2 years | 2-3 years | 3 years or more

07. According to the job announcement, check the box that most closely matches your level of proficiency to perform the minimum qualifications listed: Receiving, storing, issuing, and controlling inventory of uniforms, equipment and supplies. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

08. Overseeing the activities of students utilizing the locker room. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

09. Setting up and dismantling equipment for a variety of student activities and special events. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

10. Performing a variety of custodial duties including vacuuming, dusting, mopping and sweeping. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

11. The questions below are designed to indicate whether you are willing to perform the duty listed. Check YES if you are willing to perform this duty or NO if you are not. Please keep in mind that all of the duties listed are REQUIRED of the position. If you are not willing to do any one of the duties listed, you will not be considered in the recruitment process. Select "YES" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
12. Walking, sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Options: Yes | No
13. Lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling moderately heavy objects. Options: Yes | No
14. Working on ladders/at heights. Options: Yes | No
15. Bending at the waist, kneeling or crouching. Options: Yes | No
16. Exposure to cleaning agents and chemicals. Options: Yes | No
17. Providing first aid, as needed. Options: Yes | No

18. Describe your experience maintaining physical education or athletic equipment. Include the organization(s) in which you have gained the experience, the types of equipment you were responsible for maintaining, the types of maintenance you performed and your level of responsibility for those tasks.
19. Describe your experience issuing, tracking and storing athletic equipment. Include the types of equipment, any record keeping techniques used and your level of responsibility for those tasks.
20. Describe your experience that relates to custodial duties, including what types of cleaning equipment you used.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES: Receive, store, issue and control inventory of uniforms, equipment and supplies to Physical Education classes and athletic teams; inspect for proper fit and protection; mark equipment; assure that equipment issued to students is returned. Issue loaned uniforms to students; inspect and launder returned items returned; perform minor repair of uniforms and equipment as necessary. Oversee the activities of students utilizing the locker room; assign lockers and issue locks to students; assist students having problems with locks; repair locks as needed; set combination locks. Set up and dismantle equipment for a variety of student activities and special events; layout, line and set up athletic fields; weed and remove trash from athletic fields; water and mow athletic fields as necessary; drag track, softball and baseball fields. Perform a variety of custodial duties including vacuuming, dusting, mopping and sweeping; pick up trash and empty waste receptacles; remove gum and graffiti from locker room and gymnasium facilities; stock restroom supplies; lock and unlock locker rooms, hallways and surrounding areas as required. Assist in estimating need for physical education and athletic supplies and equipment; maintain inventory records; recommend equipment for repair or replacement; inventory and issue athletic awards as required. Maintain a variety of records including locker assignments and equipment usage; prepare various reports related to assigned activities. Operate a variety of athletic and custodial equipment. Travel with athletic teams as assigned; pick up and drop off District vehicles for coaches; assist in setting up and operating equipment as necessary; drive a vehicle to conduct work. Perform basic first aid as needed. OTHER DUTIES: Perform related duties as assigned. KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES: KNOWLEDGE OF: Equipment, materials and supplies used in team and individual sports and the care and maintenance of related items. Methods, materials and equipment used in custodial work. Basic record-keeping and report preparation techniques. Health and safety regulations. Proper methods of storing equipment, materials and supplies. Basic inventory techniques. Proper field dimensions, field markings and equipment used for various sports. ABILITY TO: Receive, store, issue and control inventory of uniforms, equipment and supplies to Physical Education classes and athletic teams. Set up and dismantle equipment for a variety of student activities and special events. Operate a variety of athletic and cleaning equipment Maintain and repair athletic clothing and equipment. Understand and follow oral and written directions. Maintain records and prepare reports. Oversee the activities of students utilizing the locker room. WORKING CONDITIONS: ENVIRONMENT: Physical Education and athletic facilities environment. Subject to working outdoors. Driving a vehicle to conduct work. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate and repair athletic equipment. Walking, sitting or standing for extended periods of time. Lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling moderately heavy objects. Climbing ladders to put up nets, fix scoreboards and cleaning lights. Reaching overhead, above the shoulders and horizontally. Bending at the waist, kneeling or crouching. Heavy physical labor. HAZARDS: Exposure to cleaning chemicals. Working at heights. Ewing Consultants, Inc., August 2016
